title: Cal AI: Treating paywalls as a product surface and testing relentlessly
summary: Superwall case study on how Cal AI ran 123 paywall experiments across 46 trigger points and grew monthly revenue 3x+ in 10 months. Zach's own contribution is one quote: treat paywalls like the product, ship fast, measure, iterate. The rest is Superwall and agency commentary.

principles.text: Treat the paywall like the product: ship something, measure it, improve it tomorrow.
principles.quote: We treat paywalls the same way we treat the product — ship something, measure it, and improve it tomorrow.

principles.text: Don't spend weeks debating paywall design; just run the test.
principles.quote: If you're spending weeks debating what your paywall should look like, you've already lost. Just test it.
